p5.mindset: You might not even have noticed that your oshi's color changed.
Penlights around you are free to be anything. They may not have the official colors.
Not knowing other members' colors is normal. Nobody can watch every stream and clip.
Sometimes an oshi asks for a color only in members-only streams.
People with color vision diversity see some colors differently from you, and they enjoy it positively, not sadly.
Even if the oshi button lets your top oshi slip out, they keep cheering with all their heart.
Some operate the penlight blind at god speed so they never miss a moment, and the buttons cannot keep up.
Your oshi has a heart strong enough to turn a wrong penlight color into a joke. No need to worry.
p5.quote: "Can't you guys just get along, seriously?"

p14.items: Page 1 gets the oshi button (Hot Button) (set it in ⚙).
The lock button size on page 1 can be changed (in ⚙).
The size and position of the penlight color, the color boxes and the member names on page 1 can be changed (in ⚙).
Member images (from your phone or an image URL) can be shown see-through on top of the penlight color on page 1 (in ⚙).
Surprise guest members can be shown or hidden (OFF by default).
Half-circle hit areas can be shown in color, with adjustable transparency.
Page 5 scores become "95 pts♠" (correct, fewest presses) / "67 pts" (correct, longer way) / "2 pts♠" (so close!), and "Got it!" shows your answer list.
“About this app” gets data management (backup, delete) and the CSV editor download / delete.
Leaving the page or closing the app turns debug mode off again.
